derivatives.zh: 似爬行类生物（科幻复数）

senses.title: Relating to reptiles
senses.definition: of, relating to, or belonging to reptiles
senses.definitionCN: 属于、关于或与爬行动物有关的
senses.example: The reptilian eye narrowed to a vertical slit.
senses.exampleCN: 那只爬行动物般的眼睛缩成一条竖缝。
senses.why: The suffix -ian turns the noun reptile into a relational adjective, so reptilian answers 'of what group?'
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ian 把名词 reptile 变成表关系的形容词，因此 reptilian 回答「属于哪一类」。

senses.title: Having reptile-like physical traits
senses.titleCN: 具有爬行动物般的外形特征
senses.definition: showing scales, dry skin, a low stance or a cold, fixed gaze
senses.definitionCN: 呈现鳞片、干燥皮肤、低伏姿态或冷硬不动的凝视
senses.example: The mask gave him a reptilian appearance.
senses.exampleCN: 那张面具让他看起来像爬行动物。
senses.why: The adjective extends from real reptiles to anything that looks like one, so scales and stillness become the visual cues.
senses.whyCN: 形容词从真实爬行动物扩展到任何看起来像爬行动物的东西，鳞片与静止便成了视觉线索。

senses.title: Cold and unemotional
senses.definition: describing a person or behaviour seen as cold, calculating and unfeeling
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个人或行为冷酷、算计、没有感情
senses.example: He answered with a reptilian calm that unsettled the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他以一种爬行动物般的冷静作答，让全场不安。
senses.why: The figurative sense borrows the reptile's reputed coldness and lack of expression, turning biology into a moral judgement.
senses.whyCN: 比喻义借用了爬行动物「冷血」与「无表情」的名声，把生物学变成道德评判。

senses.title: The 'reptilian brain' in popular science
senses.titleCN: 通俗科学中的「爬行动物脑」
senses.definition: a popular term for primitive, instinct-driven brain functions, supposed to resemble the reptile brain
senses.definitionCN: 通俗术语，指原始的、由本能驱动的脑功能，据说类似爬行动物的脑
senses.example: The reptilian brain is said to handle fear and territory.
senses.exampleCN: 所谓爬行动物脑被认为负责恐惧与领地。
senses.why: The triune-brain model gave ancient instincts a reptilian label; the term is a metaphor, not an anatomical finding.
senses.whyCN: 「三层脑」模型给古老本能贴上爬行动物标签；这个说法是比喻，并非解剖学结论。

senses.title: A reptilian fossil assemblage
senses.definition: used of a fossil fauna made up chiefly of reptile remains
senses.definitionCN: 用于指主要由爬行动物遗骸构成的化石动物群
senses.example: The reptilian fauna of the red beds includes several dinosaurs.
senses.exampleCN: 红层的爬行动物群包括好几种恐龙。
senses.why: Palaeontology needs an adjective to describe a whole assemblage, where 'reptile' would suggest a single animal.
senses.whyCN: 古生物学需要形容词来描述整个组合，用名词 reptile 会让人以为指单个动物。

senses.title: Of the reptile lineage
senses.definition: belonging to the evolutionary lineage that includes reptiles and, in modern classification, birds
senses.definitionCN: 属于包含爬行动物、现代分类中还包括鸟类的演化支
senses.example: Birds are reptilian in the strict evolutionary sense.
senses.exampleCN: 从严格的演化意义上说，鸟类属于爬行类支系。
senses.why: Modern phylogeny puts birds inside the reptile tree, so the adjective can describe a lineage rather than a body plan.
senses.whyCN: 现代系统发生学把鸟类放在爬行类树内，因此这个形容词可以描述演化支，而非身体形态。

senses.title: A reptile-like being in fiction
senses.titleCN: 科幻中的似爬行类生物
senses.definition: a fictional humanoid or alien with reptile features
senses.definitionCN: 具有爬行动物特征的虚构人形或外星生物
senses.example: The reptilian in the film spoke with two voices.
senses.exampleCN: 影片中的似爬行类生物用两种声音说话。
senses.why: Fiction uses the adjective as a noun because the creature is not a real reptile but only resembles one.
senses.whyCN: 虚构作品把这个形容词用作名词，因为该生物不是真实爬行动物，只是相似。

senses.title: Reptile leather goods
senses.definition: made from the skin of snakes, crocodiles or other reptiles
senses.definitionCN: 由蛇、鳄或其他爬行动物皮革制成的
senses.example: The shop sold reptilian belts and bags.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店卖爬行动物皮革的腰带与包。
senses.why: The material trade prefers the adjective because it modifies the product noun, as in reptilian leather.
senses.whyCN: 材料行业偏好用形容词，因为它修饰产品名词，如 reptilian leather。

intro.en: Reptilian is Latin reptilis 'creeping' plus the suffix -ian; the adjective was formed in English on the noun reptile. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: reptilian 由拉丁 reptilis「爬行的」加后缀 -ian 构成；这个形容词是在英语中依名词 reptile 造出的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Reptilis meant 'creeping', from repere 'to creep'. The verb's deeper origin is unsettled, so any earlier root is a reconstruction.
items.cn: reptilis 意为「爬行的」，来自 repere「爬行」。该动词的更深来源没有定论，凡更早的词根都属重构。

items.en: The suffix -ian, from Latin -ianus through French, forms adjectives of belonging, as in mammalian and amphibian.
items.cn: 后缀 -ian 经法语来自拉丁 -ianus，构成表归属的形容词，如 mammalian 与 amphibian。

items.en: English reptilian appears in the nineteenth century, when zoology needed a relational adjective beside the noun reptile.
items.cn: 英语 reptilian 在 19 世纪出现，当时动物学需要一个与名词 reptile 相配的关系形容词。

items.en: By the later nineteenth century the adjective was applied to cold, unblinking people as well as to animals.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪后期，这个形容词除了动物，也用于形容冷酷、不眨眼的人。

items.en: The phrase 'reptilian brain' spread in the 1960s with the triune-brain model; it is a popular metaphor, not a literal description of human anatomy.
items.cn: reptilian brain 一说随 1960 年代的「三层脑」模型流行；它是通俗比喻，并非对人体解剖的写实描述。

items.en: Source uncertain (details only): the Latin and suffix stages are clear, but repere's pre-Latin origin is unsettled and the first English use is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅细节）：拉丁与后缀阶段清楚，但 repere 的拉丁语之前来源没有定论，英语首见年代也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds forms from the same reptile family; group two holds adjectives for the cold or scaly quality that reptilian also conveys.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 reptile 词族的形式；第二组是同样传达「冷」或「有鳞」质感的形容词。

entries.definition: The animal itself; reptilian is the adjective and cannot replace it as a subject.
entries.definitionCN: 动物本身；reptilian 是形容词，不能作主语代替它。

entries.definition: The formal Latin class; reptilian describes anything belonging to or resembling it.
entries.definitionCN: 正式拉丁纲名；reptilian 描述属于或类似该纲的事物。

entries.definition: A botanical adjective for creeping stems; it shares the Latin verb but is not used of animals.
entries.definitionCN: 植物学形容词，指匍匐茎；同出拉丁动词，但不用于动物。

entries.definition: Built with -oid 'like', it stresses resemblance without membership, whereas reptilian can mean either.
entries.definitionCN: 由 -oid「像」构成，强调相似而非归属；reptilian 则两种意思都可。

entries.definition: Literally describing an animal that depends on external heat, figuratively describing a cruel person; reptilian leans on the figurative side.
entries.definitionCN: 字面指依赖外部热量的动物，比喻指残忍的人；reptilian 更偏比喻一面。

entries.definition: Of or like lizards, from Greek sauros 'lizard'; it is narrower than reptilian and suggests a lizard shape.
entries.definitionCN: 指蜥蜴的或像蜥蜴的，来自希腊 sauros「蜥蜴」；比 reptilian 窄，暗示蜥蜴形态。

entries.definition: Snake-like in movement or form; it stresses winding motion, which reptilian does not.
entries.definitionCN: 在动作或形态上像蛇；强调蜿蜒运动，而 reptilian 不含此意。

entries.definition: A technical word for scaled reptiles such as snakes and lizards; it is a taxonomic category, not a description of mood.
entries.definitionCN: 指蛇、蜥蜴等有鳞爬行动物的技术词；它是分类范畴，不描述情绪。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: reptile + -ian: the adjective of the reptile group.
normal.cn: reptile + -ian：爬行动物类群的形容词。

normal.en: Reptilian eye and reptilian calm both use the same cold, unblinking image.
normal.cn: reptilian eye 与 reptilian calm 用的是同一个「冷而不用眨」的形象。

normal.en: The reptilian brain is a popular metaphor from the triune-brain model, not a real brain part.
normal.cn: reptilian brain 是「三层脑」模型带来的通俗比喻，不是真实存在的脑区。

normal.en: In modern phylogeny birds are reptilian, even though they do not look like lizards.
normal.cn: 现代系统发生学中鸟类属于爬行类支系，尽管它们看起来不像蜥蜴。

normal.en: Reptiloid says 'looks like'; reptilian says 'belongs to or looks like'.
normal.cn: reptiloid 只说「像」；reptilian 则兼指「属于」与「像」。

abstract.en: Picture a gaze that never blinks and never gives anything away.
abstract.cn: 想象一道从不眨眼、也从不流露任何东西的目光。

abstract.en: Picture an ancient instinct wearing a lizard's face.
abstract.cn: 想象一种古老本能长着一张蜥蜴的脸。

abstract.en: Picture a bird that is, in the family tree, a reptile with feathers.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鸟，在家谱上其实是一只长了羽毛的爬行动物。

examples.en: The lizard's reptilian skin keeps water loss to a minimum.
examples.cn: 蜥蜴的爬行动物皮肤把水分散失降到最低。

examples.en: His reptilian stare made the interview feel like an interrogation.
examples.cn: 他那爬行动物般的凝视让采访像审讯。

examples.en: The film's reptilian villains were entirely computer-generated.
examples.cn: 片中那些似爬行类的反派完全由电脑生成。

dict_mnemonic.text: reptile（爬行动物）+ ian（的）——爬行动物的；想到竖瞳与冷光，就记住「像爬行动物般冷酷」

root: 拉丁 reptilis「爬行的」（来自 repere「爬行」）+ 后缀 -ian；repere 的更深词源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one cold, scaly image from zoology to metaphor: the group adjective, the physical look, emotional coldness, the 'reptilian brain', fossil faunas, the evolutionary lineage, fictional beings and leather goods.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让同一个冷而有鳞的形象从动物学走向比喻：类群形容词、外形、情感冷酷、「爬行动物脑」、化石动物群、演化支、虚构生物与皮革制品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vertical slit pupil in cold light, motionless and unreadable.
core.cn: 核心意象：冷光中的一条竖瞳，静止而读不出情绪。

branches.en: MEMBERSHIP: the adjective marks belonging, whether to the class or to its evolutionary lineage.
branches.cn: 归属：形容词标记归属，无论指纲还是指演化支。

branches.en: SURFACE: scales and skins are the visible, tradeable side of the word.
branches.cn: 表面：鳞与皮是这个词可见、可交易的一面。

branches.en: TEMPERAMENT: coldness of body becomes coldness of feeling.
branches.cn: 性情：身体的冷变成情感的冷。

branches.en: INSTINCT: popular science gives ancient drives a reptile label.
branches.cn: 本能：通俗科学给古老驱力贴上爬行动物标签。

branches.en: DEEP AND IMAGINED: fossil beds and invented aliens both wear the adjective.
branches.cn: 深时与想象：化石层与虚构外星生物都披着这个形容词。

intro.en: Reptilian is a transparent derivative of reptile, built with the productive suffix -ian; the stem itself goes back to a Latin verb.
intro.cn: reptilian 是 reptile 的透明派生词，由能产后缀 -ian 构成；词干本身可上溯到拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin repere 'to creep' gives reptilis and reptilium; English draws reptile, reptilian and reptant from the same stock.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 repere「爬行」衍生 reptilis 与 reptilium；英语的 reptile、reptilian、reptant 同出这一词族。

items.example: The stem carries the low, creeping motion.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干带着低伏爬行的动作。

items.example: Reptilis means given to creeping.
items.exampleCN: reptilis 意为惯于爬行的。

items.example: The suffix makes the group adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成类群形容词。

items.meaningCN: 爬行动物的；像爬行动物的
items.example: The reptilian eye never blinked.
items.exampleCN: 那只爬行动物般的眼睛从不眨。

items.example: The story is full of reptilians.
items.exampleCN: 这个故事里满是似爬行类生物。

items.example: A reptile warmed itself on the stone.
items.exampleCN: 一只爬行动物在石上取暖。

items.example: The reptant stem spread across the ground.
items.exampleCN: 匍匐茎在地面铺开。

items.example: The mask had a reptiloid shape.
items.exampleCN: 面具呈似爬行动物的形状。

definition_zh: 哺乳动物（有毛发、用乳汁哺育幼崽的温血脊椎动物）
definition_en: a warm-blooded vertebrate with hair that feeds its young with milk
core_image: 洞穴深处，母兽侧躺，幼崽紧贴腹部吸奶，毛上还带着夜里的凉气
scene: 洞穴口，母兽侧躺，幼崽紧贴腹部吸奶，毛上还带着夜里的凉气。 The mammal nursed her young in the dark, her body warm against the cold ground.
sceneCN: 这里 mammal 指「哺乳动物」（第 1 个义项：有毛发、以乳汁哺育幼崽的温血脊椎动物）；句意为这只哺乳动物在黑暗中给幼崽喂奶，身体贴着冷地面仍保持温暖。

forms.label: 复合形容词（似哺乳类的）

senses.title: A member of the class Mammalia
senses.definition: a vertebrate that is warm-blooded, has hair or fur, and feeds its young with milk from mammary glands
senses.definitionCN: 温血、有毛发、用乳腺分泌的乳汁哺育幼崽的脊椎动物
senses.example: The mammal nursed her young in the dark.
senses.exampleCN: 这只哺乳动物在黑暗中给幼崽喂奶。
senses.why: The word is built on Latin mamma 'breast', so the defining feature is the gland that makes milk.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在拉丁 mamma「乳房」之上，因此定义特征是产乳的腺体。

senses.title: The class as a whole
senses.definition: the mammals collectively, one class of vertebrates
senses.definitionCN: 所有哺乳动物的集合，是脊椎动物的一个纲
senses.example: Mammals appeared only after the dinosaurs had declined.
senses.exampleCN: 哺乳动物直到恐龙衰落之后才兴盛起来。
senses.why: As a formal class, the plural often names a category in evolution rather than a group of individuals.
senses.whyCN: 作为一个正式纲，复数常指演化中的一个范畴，而不是一群个体。

senses.title: A marine mammal
senses.definition: a mammal that lives in the sea, such as a whale, seal or dolphin
senses.definitionCN: 生活在海中的哺乳动物，如鲸、海豹或海豚
senses.example: The bay is a nursery for marine mammals.
senses.exampleCN: 这个海湾是海洋哺乳动物的育幼场。
senses.why: The category crosses habitats, so 'marine' is added to keep the milk-and-hair definition while changing the setting.
senses.whyCN: 这一范畴跨越生境，因此加 marine 来保留「哺乳与毛发」的定义，同时改变场景。

senses.title: A conservation target
senses.definition: a mammal species or population managed to prevent decline or extinction
senses.definitionCN: 为防止数量下降或灭绝而加以管理的哺乳动物物种或种群
senses.example: Mammal conservation focuses on corridors between reserves.
senses.exampleCN: 哺乳动物保护的重点是保护区之间的走廊。
senses.why: Large, visible animals attract funding and legislation, so the class name became a policy unit.
senses.whyCN: 大型、可见的动物容易获得资金与立法关注，因此纲名成了政策单元。

senses.title: A laboratory model
senses.definition: a mammal used in medical research, especially the mouse
senses.definitionCN: 用于医学研究的哺乳动物，尤指小鼠
senses.example: The mouse is the standard mammal in genetics labs.
senses.exampleCN: 小鼠是遗传学实验室里的标准哺乳动物。
senses.why: Because humans are mammals, a mammalian model lets researchers study diseases in a closely related body.
senses.whyCN: 因为人类也是哺乳动物，哺乳动物模型让研究者能在亲缘很近的身体中研究疾病。

senses.title: A fossil mammal
senses.definition: ancient mammal remains, especially teeth and jawbones used to trace diets
senses.definitionCN: 古代哺乳动物遗骸，尤指用于推断食性的牙齿与颌骨
senses.example: The fossil mammal had teeth for both plants and meat.
senses.exampleCN: 这只哺乳动物化石的牙齿既能吃植物也能吃肉。
senses.why: Mammal teeth preserve well and carry dietary information, which is why palaeontology relies on them.
senses.whyCN: 哺乳动物的牙齿易保存且携带食性信息，因此古生物学高度依赖它们。

senses.title: A vertebrate pest
senses.definition: a mammal that damages crops, stores or property, such as a rat
senses.definitionCN: 损害作物、仓储或财产的哺乳动物，如鼠
senses.example: The grain store was sealed against mammals.
senses.exampleCN: 粮仓被封住以防哺乳动物进入。
senses.why: Pest control separates mammal problems from insect problems, and the class name does that work.
senses.whyCN: 有害生物防治把哺乳动物问题与昆虫问题分开，纲名正好承担这一区分。

senses.title: A hunted game animal
senses.definition: a mammal hunted for meat, trophies or population control
senses.definitionCN: 为肉、战利品或控制数量而猎杀的哺乳动物
senses.example: The forest is managed for large game mammals.
senses.exampleCN: 这片森林按大型狩猎哺乳动物来管理。
senses.why: Hunting law uses the class name because quotas are set for deer, boar and other mammals together.
senses.whyCN: 狩猎法使用纲名，因为配额是给鹿、野猪等哺乳动物统一设定的。

intro.en: Mammal is built on Latin mamma 'breast' through Late Latin mammalis; Linnaeus fixed Mammalia as the class name. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: mammal 经晚期拉丁 mammalis 建立在拉丁 mamma「乳房」之上；林奈把 Mammalia 固定为纲名。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mamma meant 'breast'. It is probably an expressive or nursery word, and its deeper origin is not established; any Indo-European form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: mamma 意为「乳房」。它很可能是拟声或儿语词，更深来源未有定论；凡为它提出的印欧形式都属重构。

items.en: Mammalis meant 'of the breast', an adjective formed from mamma and used in anatomical writing.
items.cn: mammalis 意为「乳房的」，由 mamma 构成的形容词，用于解剖学文字。

items.en: Linnaeus used Mammalia as the class name for animals that suckle their young, placing the milk glands at the centre of the definition.
items.cn: 林奈用 Mammalia 作为哺育幼崽的动物纲名，把乳腺放在定义的核心。

items.en: English mammal appears in the 1820s through French mammifère, shortening the Latin plural Mammalia into a singular English noun.
items.cn: 英语 mammal 在 1820 年代经法语 mammifère 出现，把拉丁复数 Mammalia 缩成一个英语单数名词。

items.en: Nineteenth-century science added mammalian for the adjective and mammalogy for the field, completing the English family.
items.cn: 19 世纪科学补上形容词 mammalian 与学科名 mammalogy，完成了英语词族。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): mamma's origin is probably expressive rather than derivable, and the first English date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：mamma 的来源很可能是拟声性的，无法再往上推导，英语首见年代也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same mamma stem; group two holds vertebrate categories that sit above, below or beside mammals.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 mamma 词干的词；第二组是位于哺乳动物之上、之下或旁边的脊椎动物范畴。

entries.definition: The breast or milk gland itself; the animal name was built on it, but the noun is not the animal.
entries.definitionCN: 乳房或乳腺本身；动物名由它构成，但名词本身不是动物。

entries.definition: Relating to the milk glands, as in mammary gland; it describes a body part, not a class of animals.
entries.definitionCN: 与乳腺有关，如 mammary gland；它描述身体部位，而非动物纲。

entries.definition: The formal Latin class; Mammalia is the whole class, a mammal is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 正式拉丁纲名；Mammalia 是整个纲，mammal 是一个成员。

entries.definition: The study of mammals, built with -logy; it names a discipline rather than an animal.
entries.definitionCN: 研究哺乳动物的学科，由 -logy 构成；它指学科，不指动物。

entries.definition: Any animal with a backbone; mammals are one class within the vertebrates.
entries.definitionCN: 任何有脊柱的动物；哺乳动物是脊椎动物中的一个纲。

entries.definition: A mammal that carries its young in a pouch, such as a kangaroo; it is a subgroup of mammals.
entries.definitionCN: 把幼崽放在育儿袋里的哺乳动物，如袋鼠；它是哺乳动物的一个亚群。

entries.definition: A mammal whose young develop inside the womb attached to a placenta; another subgroup, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 幼崽在子宫内通过胎盘发育的哺乳动物；另一个亚群，并非同义词。

entries.definition: Able to maintain a steady body temperature internally; mammals generally are, but so are birds.
entries.definitionCN: 能靠自身维持稳定体温；哺乳动物大多如此，但鸟类也如此。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: mamma 'breast' + -al: the animal defined by its milk glands.
normal.cn: mamma「乳房」+ -al：以乳腺定义的那类动物。

normal.en: Mammal is singular; Mammalia is the class; mammalian is the adjective.
normal.cn: mammal 是单数个体；Mammalia 是纲；mammalian 是形容词。

normal.en: Whales and dolphins are marine mammals, not fish, because they breathe air and nurse their young.
normal.cn: 鲸与海豚是海洋哺乳动物，不是鱼，因为它们呼吸空气并哺育幼崽。

normal.en: Mammal-like is the phrase for extinct relatives that had some but not all mammal traits.
normal.cn: mammal-like 用来指已灭绝、只具备部分哺乳动物特征的近亲。

normal.en: Mammalogy is the field; mammalogist is the person.
normal.cn: mammalogy 是学科；mammalogist 是从业者。

abstract.en: Picture warmth passed from a mother's body to a blind newborn.
abstract.cn: 想象温暖从母体传给一只还看不见东西的幼崽。

abstract.en: Picture a whale that left the land but kept the milk.
abstract.cn: 想象一头离开了陆地却保留了哺乳方式的鲸。

abstract.en: Picture a fossil jaw whose teeth still tell what the animal ate.
abstract.cn: 想象一块化石颌骨，牙齿仍在说明那只动物吃什么。

examples.en: Mammals are the only animals that produce milk for their young.
examples.cn: 哺乳动物是唯一为幼崽产奶的动物。

examples.en: The survey found twelve mammal species in the valley.
examples.cn: 调查在山谷中发现十二种哺乳动物。

examples.en: Marine mammals surface to breathe every few minutes.
examples.cn: 海洋哺乳动物每隔几分钟浮出水面呼吸。

dict_mnemonic.text: mamma（妈妈）+ al——由妈妈喂奶养大的动物，就是哺乳动物；记「吃奶长大的」

root: 拉丁 mamma「乳房」→ 晚期拉丁 mammalis「乳房的」→ 林奈 Mammalia；mamma 的更深来源很可能是拟声词，无法再上推。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one milk-feeding animal through classification, evolution, oceans, conservation, laboratories, fossils, pest control and hunting.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让一种喂奶的动物穿过分类、演化、海洋、保护、实验室、化石、有害生物防治与狩猎。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mother's warm body against a newborn in a dark den.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗洞穴里，母兽温暖的身体贴着新生幼崽。

branches.en: DEFINITION: hair and milk define one animal and the whole class.
branches.cn: 定义：毛发与乳汁既定义一个动物，也定义整个纲。

branches.en: HABITAT: the same class enters the sea without ceasing to be mammals.
branches.cn: 生境：同一个纲进入海洋，却不因此不再是哺乳动物。

branches.en: MANAGEMENT: protect it, control it, or hunt it under quota.
branches.cn: 管理：保护它、防治它，或在配额下猎取它。

branches.en: RESEARCH: because humans are mammals, a mouse can stand in for us.
branches.cn: 研究：因为人类也是哺乳动物，小鼠可以代替我们。

branches.en: DEEP TIME: fossil teeth record what ancient mammals ate.
branches.cn: 深时：化石牙齿记录着古代哺乳动物吃什么。

intro.en: Mammal is a Latin-derived noun built on mamma plus the adjective ending -al, shortened from the class name Mammalia.
intro.cn: mammal 是由拉丁 mamma 加形容词词尾 -al 构成的名词，从纲名 Mammalia 缩短而来。

latinIntro.en: Latin mamma 'breast' gives mammalis 'of the breast'; Linnaeus formed Mammalia from it, and English shortened that to mammal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 mamma「乳房」衍生 mammalis「乳房的」；林奈据此造出 Mammalia，英语再缩短为 mammal。

items.example: The root supplies the milk-feeding image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「哺乳」的形象。

items.example: Mammalis means pertaining to the breast.
items.exampleCN: mammalis 意为与乳房有关的。

items.example: The mammal fed her cub.
items.exampleCN: 这只哺乳动物给幼崽喂奶。

items.example: Mammals colonised every continent.
items.exampleCN: 哺乳动物占据了每个大陆。

items.example: The suffix makes the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成形容词。

items.example: The mammalian heart has four chambers.
items.exampleCN: 哺乳动物的心脏有四个腔。

items.example: Mammalia is a class of vertebrates.
items.exampleCN: 哺乳纲是脊椎动物的一纲。

items.example: Mammalogy grew out of natural history.
items.exampleCN: 哺乳动物学从博物学中发展出来。
